title: mini-bulkhead-canary-with-entropy-driven-throttle-and-fast-rewind
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Introduces mini-bulkhead canary lanes with entropy-driven throttling and instant snapshot rewind support; backwards-compatible rollout API extensions; improved safety for high-churn A/B experiments.
description: Context: Large canaries introducing capacity spikes and correlated failures during multi-arm experiments motivated a small-surface change to the rollout controller. This PR implements a 'mini-bulkhead' primitive (tiny, isolated serving lanes) and an entropy-driven throttle algorithm that staggers fraction increases across cohorts to avoid synchronized traffic jumps. It also wires in a snapshot-based fast-rewind path: small, frequent snapshots of route state enable near-instant rollback using a rollback credit system that limits noisy fast retries. Motivation: make A/B and multi-canary promotions safer and cheaper for workloads that are sensitive to blast radius. Changes: controller/core: new MiniBulkheadManager, entropy_throttle sampler, rewind_credit ledger; api: rollout manifest v2 additions (miniBulkheads:[], entropySeed, rewindCreditPolicy); scheduler: fraction-step jitterer using per-cohort entropy seeds; snapshotter: lightweight, append-only snapshot journal with TTL and compaction; metrics: new rollout_traffic_jitter_seconds, rewind_credit_usage_total, mini_bulkhead_active_gpus; tests: end-to-end harness simulating 10k request-per-second traffic with synthetic drift; docs: design doc and quickstart; examples: AB YAML for staged micro lanes. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-1429) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added and flakiness investigated - [x] Docs and example updated - [x] Backwards compatibility smoke tested Rollout contract notes: default behavior is unchanged unless rollout manifest includes miniBulkheads; entropySeed is optional and falls back to controller-generated seed for deterministic but varied fractioning per rollout. Operational notes: rewind credits are consumed on each fast-rewind and replenished by time-based credit accrual; cluster admin can set global caps via operator config. Related: this helps mitigate incidents like SUP-5132 by reducing correlated promotion failures.

notes_for_backport: No backport required for production branch; if backporting to release/* ensure operator config default values are adjusted to conservative quotas and run integration harness under reduced load.
risk_assessment: Medium - introduces a new controller primitive and snapshot journal; default is opt-in and there are operator caps. Mitigations: opt-in by manifest, credit caps, integrated rate-limiter and metrics for rapid detection.
testing_summary: Unit coverage added for entropy_throttle and rewind ledger. Integration harness simulates drift scenarios and repeated promotions (10k RPS synthetic). Observed median promotion time increase of ~40ms due to snapshot bookkeeping; tradeoff accepted for safety. No regressions on existing rollout flows observed in smoke tests.
